title: Ruleset: difficulty
description: rules/<id>/difficulty.yaml: the levels of the player's difficulty setting (apps/game: RuleOptions), an engine improvement. Normal, the original, changes nothing; each other level changes values of the ruleset's other sections while it is played.

levels.description: The changes of each level by its name (easy...).

path.description: The value's dotted path in the section (hunger.window_minutes, patterns.2.hours).

percent.description: The new value as a percent of the ruleset's own whole number, rounded down.
